scientific_integrity: Full definitions, prime-power boundary, correct nonsquare and square divisor-count thresholds, finite verification scope, and residual novelty risk are disclosed.
scientific_limitations: The stated limits hold for each fixed prime p and are not uniform in p. The globally aggregated Schreier count is not determined. The classical fixed-prime-factor Landau theorem is an explicit input. Equivalent unindexed results cannot be ruled out.
title: Sharp least-prime strata of Schreier numbers
